messages:
Rae: Escalating from Support -> CS: trial org ClearHarbor getting 502s on embeddings since ~09:12 PDT. Support restarted pods; still failing. Need a short comm and enablement offer.
Ibrahim: Ack. Can you drop the last-good time and a sample error?
Rae: Last good 09:10. Error: `ERROR embed-service upstream 502 model=mini-embed trace=tx-44f1 err=\"kv timeout\"`
Rae: Repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"mini-embed","input":"test"}'` -> 502 from prod-us-west. INF-4217 opened.
ops-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-us-west): 42 errors / 5m.
Lina: Ops play — temp route to fallback-pool, increase tenant KV TTL to 20s, enable verbose traces for 30m. Ibrahim, can you draft a 1-2 line ack to send now?
Ibrahim: Draft: "Hi ClearHarbor 1; were aware of intermittent 502s affecting embeddings in your trial. Were routing your traffic to alternate capacity now and will update within 60 minutes. Well follow up with an RCA and optional enablement session. CS Team"
Rae: Sending that now. Lina, please execute route switch and post verification.
Lina: Route switch applied at 1719990018. Initial check: 9/10 requests OK, 1 transient 502. Verbose traces on.
ops-bot: [incident-update] INF-4217 mitigation applied (route-switch) at 1719990018.
Ibrahim: Ive flagged the account as "renewal-watch" in CRM (trial ends in 4 days). If outage >4h we'll offer a prioritized enablement session + credit guidance.
Rae: Actions: Lina (monitor + logs), Ibrahim (CRM + comms), Rae (follow-up RCA + schedule enablement if requested). Closing criteria: <0.5% errors for 30m.
Lina: Monitoring: error rate 0.7% over last 12m. Will escalate to runtime-eng if >2% for 10m.
Rae: Thanks team. Ill confirm when metrics hit closure criteria.
